data.name: The Long Way Home
data.detailed_description:
The Long Way Home is an atmospheric sci-fi stew that blends classic Point & Click and Visual Novel storytelling with a first-person (FPS) view and survival/RPG elements.

Are you ready to watch the universe through the visor of the miner’s helmet on your head?

You wake up on an abandoned ship; there’s no one else breathing here but you. Soon you realize something: the only beings you can talk to are the ship’s Artificial Intelligence, the galaxy’s odd robots, and aliens from every step of evolution.

But what about humans?

THE MYSTERY OF THE FUTURE

While trying to figure out what happened to humanity, you also have to get the ship back to Earth. Along the way, you’ll need to befriend humanoid robots, out-of-control AIs, and extremely weird aliens—trade with them, fight to survive, or solve problems through diplomacy.

A MINER’S SKILLS

Crossing the galaxy isn’t easy. On this journey, you’ll have to rely on your skills. Improve your engineering to bring scrap back to life, or use your cybersecurity talents to hack systems. Or focus purely on survival—cook and grow food, and prepare delicious meals for a first-class journey. Buy new parts to upgrade your gear and even your ship, or discover new blueprints and craft them yourself.

“WAR AND PEACE” IS A FILTHY STICK—DIRTY ON BOTH ENDS

There are many ways to get what you want. From turn-based ship battles to QTE-based melee fights; from choice-driven stealth actions to tricking minds through lies, misdirection, and manipulation. The choice is yours: will you be a hero, or will you destroy anyone who stands in your way?

YOU MUST LIVE WITH THE CONSEQUENCES OF YOUR CHOICES

There isn’t a single “right” in the universe. Sometimes an action taken for a good cause can lead to a terrible end. But no matter— a traveler always keeps moving forward. As a wise man once said: “Just as a single good deed doesn’t make us a good person, a single evil deed can’t turn us into a bad one.”

CHASING THE STORY IS UP TO YOU

Where are you? Who are you, even? Where did everyone go? What happened to humanity? Are you curious?

Explore abandoned ships, examine logs, collect curios, trade with robots, and hunt for clues on galactic web pages.

Don’t care what the story is trying to tell?

Then focus only on the mission. Don’t let anyone burden you with the galaxy’s troubles.

Your road is long, 13-553. Are you ready?

data.short_description: You are alone on a drifting starship. No humans, only robots. As Miner 13-553; craft, farm, repair, upgrade skills and find your way home. Fight the machines or choose a peaceful path. Explore the mystery or just focus on the journey. The choice is yours.

English*, Turkish, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, French, Japanese, Italian, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: The game is optimized for low-end hardware and includes graphics options to disable certain visual effects on older systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: The game is optimized for low-end hardware and includes graphics options to disable certain visual effects on older systems.
